The Department of Microeconomics and Public Economics (MPE) at the School of Business and Economics (SBE), Maastricht University, invites applications for an Assistant Professor position. We welcome candidates with a strong research profile in microeconomics, public economics, political economy, urban economics, inequality, health economics, behavioural economics, and/or experimental economics or related fields. Assistant professor position in Microeconomics and/or Public Economics Our goal: Strengthen and diversify our research and education in microeconomics and public economics – shaping knowledge that helps us understand and improve how economies and societies function. Your colleagues: You will join the vibrant, international academic community within the MPE department and the School of Business and Economics. MPE focuses on high-quality research in the above-mentioned fields. The department maintains strong links with other institutes and departments at Maastricht University and with leading international partners – offering you ample opportunity to collaborate and grow. Please visit the department’s website for more information. As Assistant Professor, you will contribute to research and education in the department. You are expected to strengthen and diversify the department’s research profile, publish in high-quality journals, and engage in external collaborations. In addition to research, you are expected to contribute to teaching at the undergraduate and graduate levels. All teaching is conducted in English. We also expect you to apply for competitive research funding. We are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive academic environment. We warmly welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from women and other groups that are currently underrepresented in academia. What You Bring We are interested in who you are and what you bring. Do you recognise yourself in this profile? Academic background – You hold a PhD in Economics or a related discipline. Strong research profile – You have a strong academic background, possibly already evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals. Funding potential – You can demonstrate the willingness or ability to secure external research funding. Teaching experience – You have experience in teaching at the university level, for example as the primary instructor or teaching assistant. Collaborative mindset – You value teamwork and collegiality, and you enjoy contributing to a positive, inclusive academic environment. You will help to create meaningful synergies and positive externalities within both the department and the School of Business and Economics. What We Offer At Maastricht University, you’ll work in an international, open, and engaged environment. We offer: An 18 month contract with the prospect of a permanent contract based on mutual satisfaction. The position is graded in scale 11 according to UFO profile Assistant Professor, with corresponding salary based on experience with a gross monthly salary between €4.925,- and €6.682,- (based on full-time employment of 38 hours per week). You will also receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8.3% year-end bonus. 29 vacation days (based on full-time), four additional days off (Carnival Monday and Tuesday, Good Friday, and Liberation Day), and the possibility to accrue up to 12 extra days through compensation hours. Flexible working hours, a home office allowance, and the option to partially work from home. A solid pension plan via ABP, company fitness schemes, and access to various university sports facilities. Freedom and responsibility to shape your work independently and develop your ideas. A close-knit community of colleagues to collaborate and grow with. An inspiring work environment in the heart of Europe. Interested? For more information with respect to the position, please contact Prof.dr. Kirsten Rohde, Chair of the hiring committee (kirsten.rohde@maastrichtuniversity.nl). For more information on the MPE department see: https://www.maastrichtuniversity.nl/research/department-microeconomics-and-public-economics Or apply directly before: November 15th 2026 The Application Should Include Curriculum Vitae (CV) Motivation letter (max 1 page) At least one example of your research (e.g. job market paper) Short research statement outlining your research vision/plans (max. 2 pages) and how you see that fitting into and complementing the research at MPE. Teaching evaluations (if available) Two letters of reference, should be sent independently by the referees to lor_algec@maastrichtuniversity.nl. We kindly ask you to apply via our application portal and not via e-mail. The e-mail mentioned above is only used for the letter of references. This position is open to internal and external candidates. We look forward to getting to know you! About About the School of Business and Economics (SBE) SBE is an international faculty for economics, business, and policy. We combine academic depth with societal engagement. Our education is small-scale and interactive. Our research focuses on themes such as sustainability, inclusion, and digital transformation. Together, we work on impactful solutions for the world of tomorrow. About Maastricht University At Maastricht University, we collaboratively seek solutions to help move the world forward. We do this with 23,300 students and 5,400 employees across 5 regional locations, 6 faculties, and more than 70 research institutes. We encourage you to push boundaries and discover new opportunities for yourself and the world around you. Together, we can find the answers for tomorrow. Maastricht University is committed to promoting and nurturing a diverse and inclusive community. We believe that diversity in our staff and student population contributes to the quality of research and education at UM, and we strive to enable this through inclusive policies and innovative projects led by teams of staff and students. review_candidates.title: VP Finance
review_candidates.location: Ramat Gan, Tel Aviv District, Israel
review_candidates.description: SkyGini is a technology-driven digital travel agency on a mission to make booking flights and hotels simpler, smarter, and fairer. We are growing rapidly, already operating at significant transaction and payment volumes in Israel, and preparing to expand into additional international markets. Behind every booking, charge, refund, and supplier payment is a complex financial operation - and managing it well is one of the key capabilities that will power our next stage of growth. About the role: We are looking for an experienced, commercially minded, and hands-on VP Finance to lead SkyGini’s finance function end to end. This role is for someone who sees finance as a business engine, not only a reporting function: someone who wants to understand where the money is moving, what is likely to happen next, where the risks and opportunities lie, and how finance can create tangible value for the business. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution. The VP Finance will be a member of the executive team, report directly to the CEO, and be expected to both lead key decisions and work directly with the models, data, systems, and processes behind them. What you will do: Lead SkyGini’s finance function end to end as a member of the executive team and a close partner to the CEO. Own cash flow and liquidity management, optimize returns on cash balances, and build policies that balance yield, availability, and risk. Optimize working capital, payment terms, settlement cycles, credit facilities, and foreign-exchange exposure. Own payment processing and reconciliation across banks, card acquirers, payment providers, customers, and suppliers. Build rolling cash-flow forecasts, budgets, and operating plans, and maintain rigorous budget-versus-actual control. Translate financial data into business insights, profitability analysis, scenarios, and performance metrics for management. Lead financial and accounting reporting, monthly and annual close processes, tax, VAT, and audits. Manage relationships with banks, auditors, authorities, card companies, and financial service providers. Build and continuously improve financial systems, processes, controls, and automation. Manage and develop the finance team and oversee the company’s outsourced finance providers. Identify and manage financial and operational risks as the company scales across markets. What we are looking for: 8–12 years of finance experience, including at least 3–5 years in a senior role with significant ownership of cash flow, liquidity, and finance operations. Hands-on experience managing cash flow, payment processing, reconciliations, and financial controls in a high-volume transaction environment. Experience in a complex financial operation; backgrounds in e-commerce, marketplaces, fintech, or similarly transaction-intensive businesses are highly relevant. Strong business judgment and the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and attention to detail. Deep understanding of financial reporting, accounting, tax, budgeting, and forecasting. Strong analytical capabilities, high personal accountability, and sound decision-making in a fast-moving environment. Proven ability to lead people, develop internal talent, and work effectively with external providers. Comfort with technology, data, and automation, together with the ability to adopt new systems and tools quickly. Fluent Hebrew and English. Significant advantages: Experience in travel, online travel, or Travel-Tech. CPA qualification. Experience with international, multi-currency operations. Experience building or implementing financial systems and processes in a growing company. Why Join SkyGini: A central executive role with direct influence on the company’s growth and key business decisions. End-to-end ownership of a critical business function operating at meaningful scale. The opportunity to build the financial infrastructure that will support Skygini’s international expansion. An entrepreneurial, technology-driven environment with room to initiate, improve, and lead. Location and working model: Our offices are located in the Ramat Gan Diamond Exchange district, within walking distance of the train station. We work four days a week from the office and one day from home. If this sounds like the right next challenge for you, we would be happy to meet you.
